summary: iter316 review: verified holiday policy CRUD (kinds, per-name persistence across years, admin-only 403, hidden/reset), payroll credit maths for hourly + hourly-worked-stacks + optional_paid-worked-no-credit + daily wage, payslip persistence of holiday_credit, event create with is_free/price/ticket_tiers, event duplicate, shared calendar feed with include_tasks (campus + mine scopes, JSON + ICS with CATEGORIES:TASK), and /api/tasks board-scoping regression (private board not visible to non-tagged user). All 16 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend spot-check: /events → /calendar redirect works, New Event dialog exposes capacity + Free checkbox + TicketTiersEditor (add-btn appears after unchecking Free), HR salary dialog exposes salary-holiday-hours field when wage_type=Hourly, Portal Profile Submit-timesheet dialog opens (holiday markers only render on weeks that contain a paid/optional-paid holiday — current week Jan 2026 has none, so dot count 0 is expected). Punches dialog could not be exercised because no timesheets with daily entries exist in the tenant; code path and data-testid are present.

If re-running the pytest, note that POST /api/hr/payslips/generate response format is inconsistent — capture ids defensively and always sweep drafts for the test user afterward. Portal timesheet holiday markers require a paid/optional_paid policy on a date in the currently-viewed week; setting Thanksgiving 'paid' and shifting the tsWeek to 2026-11-23..29 is the way to see amber dots. HR Punches dialog requires a timesheet with daily entries to exist for its 'Punches' button to render — none in the tenant.
